podcast.title: Specific Sound Micro-Genre
podcast.body: Harsh Noise Wall is identified as one of the extremely granular genres, indicative of the expanding and specific nature of modern musical categorization, featuring bands like We're Wolf and Sewer Election. "Harsh Noise Wall bands include We're Wolf, Drew, Russelam, Sleepcom, Serene ailment, and sewer election."
